ANTI-TAUTOLOGY CONTROL (DIFFERENT op of SAME opnorm=1.0=1, twisted parity P_tw=U_rot*P, NOT the below-geometry): orientation score stays min 2.0 (~2, INTACT); paired against genuine parity on the SAME inputs the twisted swap tracks the parity swap (parity_swap_mean 0.7308 vs twisted_swap_mean 0.7308; per-input ratio min 1.0, mean 1.0). Because a comparable-magnitude operation that is NOT the below-geometry LEAVES the signature intact while the below-geometry erasure collapses it (2 -> ~0), the leg-1 collapse is a MEASURED structural collapse specific to destroying the anticommutation {P,gamma5}=0, NOT an algebraic tautology. gamma5 (the readout) is held FIXED throughout; the only thing varied is the GROUP ELEMENT W.
